questions.question:
Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of an algorithm?
a. Finiteness
b. Definiteness
c. Ambiguity
d. Input
questions.explanation: Ambiguity is NOT a valid characteristic. Every step of an algorithm must be clearly and unambiguously defined.

questions.question:
What does the term 'multiplicity' refer to in the context of a multiset?
a. Number of elements in the multiset
b. Number of unique elements in the multiset
c. Number of times an element appears in the multiset
d. Total number of multisets that can be formed from a given set

options.A: Number of elements in the multiset
options.B: Number of unique elements in the multiset
options.C: Number of times an element appears in the multiset
options.D: Total number of multisets that can be formed from a given set

questions.explanation: Multiplicity refers to how many times a particular element appears in a multiset, unlike a set where each element appears only once.

questions.question:
Which approach is more suitable for problems with overlapping subproblems and optimal substructure?
a. Divide and Conquer
b. Dynamic Programming
c. Both a and b
d. Neither
questions.explanation: Dynamic Programming is specifically designed for problems with overlapping subproblems and optimal substructure, storing results to avoid recomputation.

questions.question:
Which algorithm follows the Divide and Conquer approach?
a. Bubble Sort
b. Merge Sort
c. Selection Sort
d. Heap Sort
questions.explanation: Merge Sort divides the array into halves, recursively sorts them, and merges — a classic Divide and Conquer algorithm.

questions.question:
LIFO scheme is used in ________ data structure.
a) stack
b) queue
c) linked list
d) tree
questions.explanation: Stack follows LIFO (Last In First Out) — the last element pushed is the first to be popped.

questions.question:
O-notation provides an asymptotic ________.
a) upper bound
b) lower bound
c) light bound
d) tight bound
questions.explanation: Big-O notation gives the asymptotic upper bound — it describes the worst-case growth rate of an algorithm.

questions.question:
ADT full form -
a) About Data Type
b) Abandoned Data Type
c) Abstract Data Type
d) Absolute Data Transaction
questions.explanation: ADT stands for Abstract Data Type — a mathematical model for data types defined by behavior (operations) rather than implementation.

questions.question:
In a multiset, elements are arranged in an unordered manner, with elements having a multiplicity of ________?
a) One
b) More than one
c) Zero
d) All of the above
questions.explanation: In a multiset, an element can appear zero, one, or more than one time — all multiplicities are valid.

questions.question:
Which of the following is/are property/properties of a dynamic programming problem?
a) Optimal substructure
b) Overlapping sub-problems
c) Greedy approach
d) Both optimal substructure and overlapping sub-problems

options.D: Both optimal substructure and overlapping sub-problems

questions.explanation: Dynamic Programming requires both optimal substructure (global optimum from local optima) and overlapping subproblems (subproblems repeat).

questions.question:
Time complexity depends on -
a) Compile time
b) Run time
c) both Compile time and Run time
d) None of these

options.C: both Compile time and Run time

questions.explanation: Time complexity measures the run time of an algorithm as a function of input size — compile time is not considered.

questions.question:
The main measures of the efficiency of an algorithm are?
a) Time and space complexity
b) Data and space
c) Processor and memory
d) Complexity and capacity
questions.explanation: The two primary measures of algorithm efficiency are time complexity (how fast) and space complexity (how much memory).

questions.question:
If A = {x, y, z}, number of elements of the power set of A is:
a) 6
b) 8
c) 10
d) 12
questions.explanation: Power set of a set with n elements has 2ⁿ elements. Here n=3, so 2³ = 8.
Two sets are equal if they contain exactly the same elements. {5,6,8,9} and {6,8,5,9} have the same four elements regardless of order.

questions.question:
Which of the following is asymptotically smallest?
a) n
b) log n
c) n log n
d) 2n
questions.explanation: log n grows slowest among the options — O(log n) < O(n) < O(n log n) < O(2ⁿ) for large n.

questions.question:
Name of the data structure used by recursion is:
a) Stack
b) Queue
c) Array
d) Linked list
questions.explanation: Recursion uses the call stack — each function call is pushed onto the stack and popped when it returns.

questions.question:
Big O notation derives the ________ case.
a) Best
b) Average
c) Worst
d) All cases
questions.explanation: Big-O notation represents the worst-case (upper bound) time complexity of an algorithm.

questions.question:
________ notation gives the lower bound of the function f(n).
a) Big-O
b) Theta
c) Omega
d) None
questions.explanation: Omega (Ω) notation gives the asymptotic lower bound — it describes the best-case growth rate of an algorithm.

questions.question:
Which of the following best defines space complexity?
a) Time taken by an algorithm to execute
b) Amount of memory used by an algorithm as a function of input size
c) Number of operations performed
d) Size of the input data

options.A: Time taken by an algorithm to execute
options.B: Amount of memory used by an algorithm as a function of input size

questions.explanation: Space complexity measures the total memory (including auxiliary space) an algorithm needs relative to input size.
